title: Rotten meat

# Rotten meat

Internal ID: RottenMeat | Source: Putrid Hole | Usage: Clearing active Food Buffs | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Duration: 15s | Other Effect(s): Health regen: -100%, Stamina regen: -100%, Movement speed: -50%

# Introduction

Rotten meat is a type of consumable.
Consuming rotten meat has the same effect as eating Bukeperries and can be used to switch to different Foods.

## Availability

• Drops from mounds of flesh in Putrid Holes.
• Drops from Vile

Categorias: Items
